summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn, the finished-time capture and clear logic, the progress.elapsed default style, Palette.__rich__, tests, and a changelog entry. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/progress.py (new column, Task.finished_time, finished property, capture in update/advance, clear in reset and _reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (__rich__ with lazy imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import); tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column, column added to test_columns with regenerated expected output); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased section with TimeElapsedColumn and Palette.__rich__ entries). The test_columns expected output was derived by hand-tracing every clock read, not by running the test; a regex check confirmed the bar widths (25 and 16 cells) and that no old-width bars remain. Unverified: the test suite has not been executed, so the traced expectations and column layout are untested.
